Inspired by the BCFW recurrence for tilings of the amplituhedron, we introduce the general framework of plabic tangles that utilizes plabic graphs to define rational maps between products of Grassmannians called promotions. The central conjecture of the paper is that promotion maps are quasi-cluster homomorphisms, which we prove for several classes of promotions. In order to define promotion maps, we utilize mm-vector-relation configurations (mm-VRCs) on plabic graphs. We relate mm-VRCs to the degree (a.k.a ‘intersection number’) of the amplituhedron map on positroid varieties and characterize all plabic trees with intersection number one and their VRCs. Finally, we show that promotion maps admit an operad structure and, supported by the class of 44-mass box promotions, we point at new positivity properties for non-rational maps beyond cluster algebras. Promotion maps have important connections to the geometry and cluster structure of the amplituhedron and singularities of scattering amplitudes in planar 𝒩=4\mathcal{N}=4 super Yang–Mills theory.
